tasks.prompt: संलग्न दस्तावेज़ एक बिल या रसीद है। इससे ये फ़ील्ड निकालें और केवल एक JSON object लिखें, जिसकी keys ये हों: vendor (बेचने वाली दुकान/कंपनी का नाम), invoice_number, date (YYYY-MM-DD), subtotal, gst (कुल GST राशि; अगर CGST और SGST अलग-अलग लिखे हों तो दोनों का जोड़), total। subtotal, gst और total को बिना ₹ और कॉमा के सादी संख्या के रूप में लिखें।

tasks.prompt: Explain the monsoon season to a ten-year-old. Your answer must be between 50 and 80 words long.

answers.text: Monsoon season is a time of year when lots and lots of rain falls almost every day. Warm ocean air carries water over land, where it cools and turns into big rain clouds. This rain helps farmers grow rice and fills rivers and lakes. But too much rain can cause floods, so people prepare with umbrellas, raincoats, and strong houses.

Think of monsoon as nature's big watering time! Every summer, warm air over land pulls in cool, wet air from the ocean. That wet air makes lots of clouds and heavy rain for weeks or months. It helps farmers grow food, fills rivers, but can also cause floods. It's like the sky taking a long, super-soaky shower!

Monsoon is a special windy season that brings lots of rain. In summer, hot land pulls cool, wet air from the ocean. That damp air rises, cools, and turns into big rain clouds. These rains water farms and fill rivers, but too much can cause floods. After months, winds flip and dry weather returns. It's nature's giant shower!

Imagine the Earth breathing in and out! During monsoon season, warm ocean air full of water rises and blows toward land. As it cools high up, the water squeezes out like a wet sponge, making lots of rain for weeks. Farmers love it because crops grow big, but too much rain can cause floods, so people stay ready with umbrellas!

Monsoon is a special season when winds change direction and bring lots of heavy rain. In summer, warm ocean air moves over land, cools down, and dumps water like a giant shower. tasks.prompt: Explain planting trees to a ten-year-old. Begin your answer with the word 'Today'. Your answer must be between 80 and 120 words long.

answers.text: Today we can learn how to plant a tree, which is like giving the Earth a new friend! First, pick a sunny spot with soft soil. Dig a hole twice as wide as the roots but just as deep. Gently place the young tree inside, keeping it straight and tall. Fill the hole back with soil and press it softly. Give it lots of water to drink. Add mulch like wood chips around it, but not touching the trunk. Watch it grow each year, giving shade, homes for birds, and clean air!

They give us fresh air, shade on hot days, homes for birds and squirrels, and yummy fruits. When you plant a tree, you help nature, fight pollution, and leave a green gift for the future. Let's plant one together!

answers.text: योग एक मज़ेदार खेल जैसा है जो तुम्हारे शरीर और मन को मज़बूत और शांत बनाता है। इसमें तुम अलग अलग तरह से हाथ पैर मोड़ते हो, लंबी साँस लेते हो और आँखें बंद करके शांत बैठते हो। जैसे शेर बनकर दहाड़ना, पेड़ बनकर एक पैर पर खड़ा होना या साँप की तरह लेटकर उठना। रोज़ थोड़ी देर योग करने से तुम पढ़ाई में ध्यान लगा पाओगे, खेल में तेज़ दौड़ पाओगे और मन खुश रहेगा।

योग एक मजेदार खेल जैसा व्यायाम है जो तुम्हारे शरीर को लचीला बनाता है और मन को शांत करता है । इसमें तुम पेड़ जैसे खड़े होते हो या बिल्ली जैसे झुकते हो और गहरी सांस लेते हो । रोज थोड़ी देर योग करने से तुम पढ़ाई में अच्छा ध्यान लगा पाते हो और खेल में कम थकते हो । यह सुबह उठकर करने में मजा आता है और दिन भर खुशी मिलती है ।

पैसे बचाना जीवन की सबसे महत्वपूर्ण आदतों में से एक है। इसका अर्थ है अपनी आय से कम खर्च करना और भविष्य के लिए कुछ धन सुरक्षित रखना। बचत हमें कठिन समय में सहारा देती है जैसे बीमारी बेरोजगारी या अचानक आने वाली मुसीबत। नियमित बचत से हम अपने सपनों को पूरा कर सकते हैं जैसे घर खरीदना बच्चों की पढ़ाई या सुखद बुढ़ापा। बचत करने के लिए बजट बनाना जरूरी है। फिजूलखर्ची से बचना चाहिए और छोटी छोटी बचत को भी महत्व देना चाहिए। बैंक या अन्य सुरक्षित जगहों पर धन रखने से वह बढ़ता भी है। बचत से आत्मविश्वास और मानसिक शांति मिलती है।

tasks.prompt: Explain morning walks to a ten-year-old. Do not use any commas in your answer. Your answer must be between 80 and 120 words long.

answers.text: Morning walks are like a gentle adventure right outside your door. When you step out early the air feels fresh and cool and the world feels quiet and new. Birds sing songs to wake up the sun and trees stretch tall in soft golden light. Your legs get strong and your brain feels wide awake for school and fun. You can spot bugs and clouds and friendly neighbors waving hello. Walking helps your heart beat happy and your mood feel bright and calm all day long.

Morning walks are like a fun adventure to start your day fresh and bright. You step outside while the air feels cool and clean. Birds sing songs and the sun wakes up slowly in the sky. Your legs move and stretch after a long night of sleep. Your brain feels sharp and ready for school or play. You can spot cool bugs or pretty flowers along the path. Walking with family or friends makes it even better. It gives you energy and a happy mood that lasts all day long.

Morning walks are short trips outside right after you wake up and get ready for the day. You step into fresh air and feel the sun warm your face while birds sing sweet songs. You move your legs and swing your arms and breathe deep and slow. You can see bright flowers and tall trees and funny dogs on leashes. You can walk with family or friends and talk and laugh together. Morning walks help your body grow strong and your mind feel calm and happy and ready to learn and play all day long

Morning walks are like a fresh start button for your day. When you step outside early you feel cool air on your face and hear birds sing their happy songs. Your legs get strong as you move and your heart pumps fast in a good way. You can see the sun rise and paint the sky pink and gold. You might spot a bunny or smell sweet flowers. Walking helps your brain wake up so school feels easier and fun. It also makes you calm and bright all day long.

Morning walks are fun adventures you take early in the day when the sun is just waking up. You step outside and feel cool fresh air on your face. You can hear birds sing sweet songs and see bright dew on soft green grass. Your legs get strong while your heart beats happy and fast. You might spot a sleepy cat or a friendly neighbor waving hello. Walking helps your brain think clear thoughts for school and play. It makes you feel calm and brave and ready for a great day ahead of you

Morning walks are like a secret adventure before school starts and the world wakes up. You step outside and the air feels fresh and cool on your face. Birds sing loud songs and the sun slowly paints the sky gold and pink. Your legs get strong and your brain feels happy and awake. You might see dewdrops on grass or a sleepy cat or a friendly neighbor waving hello. Walking helps you think clear thoughts and feel calm and brave for the day. It is free fun and good exercise that makes your heart smile.

Today working from home means a grown-up does their job from your house instead of traveling to an office building.

उनके साथ प्यार से खेलना चाहिए और उन्हें कभी परेशान नहीं करना चाहिए।
वे बीमार लगें तो घर के बड़ों को जल्दी बताना चाहिए।

उसके रहने की जगह साफ रखो और उसे रोज खेलने और घूमने दो।

उसे प्यार से सहलाओ और कभी ज़ोर से मत पकड़ो
अगर वह उदास या बीमार लगे तो घर के बड़ों को बताओ

tasks.prompt: Write a short paragraph about saving electricity at home. Do not use any commas in your answer. Your answer must be between 50 and 80 words long.

answers.text: You can save electricity at home by turning off lights when you leave a room and unplugging devices that you are not using each day. Use energy efficient bulbs and wash clothes in cold water to cut power use. Open curtains for natural light and run fans instead of air conditioning when weather allows comfort

Turning off lights when you leave a room is a simple way to save power each day. You can also unplug chargers and devices when they are not in use because they still draw energy. Using LED bulbs and natural daylight helps reduce costs too. Washing clothes with cold water and air drying them saves even more electricity over time

Saving electricity at home starts with small daily habits that truly add up over time. Turn off lights when leaving each room and unplug chargers when devices are fully charged. Use natural daylight whenever possible and switch to energy efficient LED bulbs. Wash clothes with cold water and run full loads only. These simple actions lower bills and help protect our planet.

Reducing electricity use at home helps save money and protect the planet. You can turn off lights when you leave a room and unplug chargers when they are not needed. Using LED bulbs saves lots of energy over time. Washing clothes in cold water and air drying them also helps. Small daily habits create big savings for every family.

Turn off lights when you leave each room and use natural daylight whenever possible. Switch to LED bulbs which use less energy and last much longer. Unplug chargers and devices when they are not needed. Wash clothes in cold water and dry them outside. Set your thermostat lower in winter and use fans instead of air conditioning during warm months

You can save electricity at home with small daily habits that lower bills and protect the planet. Turn off lights when you leave a room and unplug chargers when not in use.
